item.title: Apostle Paul — Genealogy & Life: From Infancy to Death
item.description: Note on Andronicus & Junia (Romans 16:7): Paul calls them "my kinsmen and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me." This indicates Paul had believing relatives who came to faith in Christ even before his own conversion.
